post_clip.description: At approximately 4.5s–5.5s, a dark SUV (center lane) appears to make sudden, aggressive contact with a white sedan ahead and to its left, causing the white sedan to swerve sharply right and nearly collide with a black car in the adjacent lane. The SUV’s trajectory and abrupt maneuver suggest a collision or near-collision event; the white sedan’s rapid lateral movement and visible distortion of its path indicate impact or evasive action due to impact. No debris is clearly visible, but the abnormal vehicle dynamics (sudden deceleration/deflection of the white sedan while the SUV continues forward) strongly indicate a road accident.

The impact causes the SUV to jolt and shift position visibly. The dark sedan then continues forward, but the collision is evident from vehicle deformation, abrupt motion, and the SUV’s displacement. This constitutes a clear road accident (vehicle collision).
